song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

# Parse each line: format "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT ..."
parsed_songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        print(f"Unexpected format: {line}")
        continue
    song_part = parts[0]
    release_part = parts[1]
    # Split song_part on " BY "
    if ' BY ' not in song_part:
        print(f"No BY separator: {song_part}")
        continue
    title, artists_str = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
    parsed_songs.append({
        'title': title.strip(),
        'artists': artists,
        'release': release_part.strip(),
        'line': line
    })

print(f"Parsed {len(parsed_songs)} songs")
for s in parsed_songs:
    print(s)
